people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: So David’s young men turned on their way, and went back, and came and told him all these words.
translations.bsb: So David’s men turned around and went back, and they relayed to him all these words.
translations.kjv: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.
translations.asv: So David's young men turned on their way, and went back, and came and told him according to all these words.
